name: Tales From The SMP: The Haunted Mansion
source:
"We make a great team!"

Tales From The SMP: The Haunted Mansion is a free-to-play visual novel based off of Karl Jacobs' very own "Tales From The SMP", but with a bit of a twist! Join Karl and his friends in venturing through a very spooky mansion and survive!

[From [url=https://kiolite.itch.io/tftsmp-the-haunted-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
